senses.definition: n.pr.loc. near Hamath Ez 47:16 (contr.from בְּאֵרוֹתָה?), cf. foll.;—hardly = Berytus (Beirût) with wh. form of name might agree v. Steph. Byzant. al. in MoversPhen. ii. i, 110 n.; perhaps Bereitān near Baalbek, v. Furrer ZPV viii, 34.
